title: Paired-activity learning screens 12 million molecules for mutant-selective EGFR inhibitors
summary: A mutant-aware paired-activity regression framework trained on matched bioactivity data, followed by a support vector machine classifier for triple-mutant activity, screened 12 million molecules against EGFR L858R/T790M/C797S versus wild type. It gave 16 consensus hits; five were prioritized for biochemical evaluation and two characterized further. Crystal structures of mutant EGFR with the best compounds showed two distinct noncovalent binding modes in the ATP-binding cleft. Preprint; potency values are not given in the abstract.
